plugins.//: @semantic-release/npm only bumps the package.json at pkgRoot, so it would never touch the root manifest. That matters here because bin/index.ts reads its own version from an imported package.json, which resolveJsonModule compiles into lib/package.json from the ROOT manifest. Bump the root first and rebuild, or the 0.0.5 tarball reports `--version 0.0.4`. Runs before the npm plugin because prepare steps execute in plugin order.

The repo root is `"private": true` and stays that way; package.sh flips the copy in package/ to false. @semantic-release/npm reads pkgRoot's manifest, and skips publishing outright when it sees private true, so pkgRoot must be the built directory.
package-lock.json is listed because `npm version` rewrites the version in it too, and leaving it behind would put the manifest and the lockfile out of step.
No failure issue: the workflow run already reports it, and the fail step's own GraphQL call has erred here before and masked the real cause.
